idiom_name: frozen dataclass cases + union alias + match with typing.assert_never
implementation_notes: Python has no sealed types, so the idiom is assembled: one `@dataclass(frozen=True)` per case (value equality, generated `__init__`/`__repr__`, non-destructive `dataclasses.replace`), a module-level union alias (`Payment = Card | Transfer`) as the single declaration of the closed set, and `match` (3.10+) or `isinstance` chains as the eliminator with `typing.assert_never` in the final arm - the type checker (mypy's `exhaustive-match` error code, pyright's `reportMatchNotExhaustive`) then reports the missing case at the `assert_never` call. Enforcement is entirely static: nothing prevents a subclass or a stray `# type: ignore`, so the union alias must remain the single source of truth and CI must run the checker. The classic ABC-plus-visitor form is only worth it when the set must be closed at runtime (plugin registries, deserialization dispatch) or when cases carry behaviour; for pure data the dataclass plus union pair is the idiomatic replacement.
code_sketch:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import assert_never
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Card: number: str
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Transfer: iban: str
Payment = Card | Transfer        # one alias declares the closed set

def describe(p: Payment) -> str:
    match p:
        case Card(number):   return number
        case Transfer(iban): return iban
        case _:              assert_never(p)     # type error on a new case
pitfalls: `frozen=True` is shallow and conditional: nested lists/dicts stay mutable, and an unhashable field makes the whole case unhashable because `__hash__` is generated from the fields.

Nothing is checked at runtime: a `case _: return None` arm swallows new cases, and `assert_never` only works where the checker can prove unreachability (`assert False` buys nothing, as the typing guide notes).
The closed set is a plain alias: a case class added somewhere else without extending the alias leaves the union stale, and `# type: ignore` comments erase the guarantee silently.
